description: Data-driven catalog of the structured, model-agnostic config files the config-UI surfaces. `editable_in_ui` marks the surfaces the Config files / Settings tabs render with native editors; anything still false round-trips through Import… of a JSON bundle. apply_config writes each via its managed-file renderer (consumer lines outside the playbook marker blocks are preserved).

files.note: Extra ignore patterns appended outside the playbook marker block.
Extra CodeRabbit path filters. path_instructions (objects) round-trip via JSON import.
Model-agnostic surface; projected to Claude today, Gemini/Cursor per hook targets (capability-gated).
Native hook editor (id + common fields + arg/stage/dep lists). Unknown keys from an imported bundle are preserved verbatim.

Native server editor (id/description/transport/command|endpoint/scope/auth/env/capabilities_hint). scope: personal is disallowed at the project layer; records are validated downstream by scripts/mcp/validate.py.
